installCommand: npm install && node ./node_modules/prisma/build/index.js generate --schema=backend/prisma/schema.prisma || (echo '--- PRISMA GENERATE FAILED: diagnostics ---'; echo 'node_modules/prisma:'; ls -d node_modules/prisma 2>&1; echo 'node_modules/@prisma:'; ls -d node_modules/@prisma 2>&1; echo 'node_modules/.bin:'; ls node_modules/.bin 2>&1 | head -40; echo 'ignore-scripts:'; npm config get ignore-scripts; echo 'NODE_ENV:'; echo "${NODE_ENV:-unset}"; exit 1)
buildCommand: npm install --prefix frontend && cd frontend && npx tsc && npx vite build
